content.text: Anatu Porai Wakasa doko embena tembole anda doko namba mona nyilyu.
Mona nyepala namba dokona karapuli lao suu pyale pyale karo.
Nambana yongo mona dolapona piso renge kuiyuo Anatu lete karenge dokona lao raemaiyuo wee romope lao karo.
Kamongo emba Porai Wakasa nambana kiŋi dee nambana Anatu.
Yaka mambiname dupwame nakamana yakanedupwa
embena mena pyao kiso jingi kana pyare lenge dokona repeta anda pyuo retapala rapu pyuo petenge.
Wambu embena tembole anda palyuo karo piso pingi dupwame
embapa rae maipala yuu peparae kenane pyao lakandenge.
Wambu dupwa emba keta porai renge nyepala
yuukyau Sayone dokona panya rae wakasa maiyuo karaminyi.
Yuu pau lama lama ketange pyasi kingi Baka lenge dokona yalo pelyaminyi dokopa
ipwa guu lanyi pyakamenge.
Apu epa nange mange dokopa wambo epapala pete kuki malu simusae pingi.
Nakama pao dokopa ando poraiyuo penge.
Nakama mee bange anatuŋu letaminyi dupwa nyuo isa palyuo Anatu mupwa doko yuu Sayone dokona kandarami.
Kamongo Anatu Porai Wakasa dokome nambana ateŋa pii doko soo karape.
Jekopena Anatu embame sepe.
Anatu embame namwana kiŋi rombo palyakaene doko
elyape keta pisakape.
Yuu gii mendakiembena tembole anda pao pisiru doko angingyuo papala
yuu gii taosande nembo yuu wakalena mee kata papyuo kararo dusipa mee ingyuo pelyamo.
Yulu koo pinginya anda dupwana kara nao
nambana Anatunya anda kambu konandawamedokona karapuli yaka lao suu pilyu.
Kamongo doko baa namwana konambe ingyuo karo kiŋi neta renge ingyuo karenge.
Baame namwa elyape keta piso anjiki pyuo namwa nyuo ketae pyambuo karenge.
Baame wambu lapo rolae pyuo karenge dupwa
bange keyange mainya kata rokwakami nange.
Anatu Porai Wakasa doko, wambu lapome emba kapa ingingi laosuu pilyaminyi dupwa rae maiyuo kararami ingilyamo.
